nodes.text:
Quietly, if you would. I'm counting.

I sell the mending register - the words that put back. I sing them against the other thing, and as long as I'm louder here, here stays dry.

You know what. You've heard it since you came down the shelf; you've just been calling it the sea.

It's in a key. Seas aren't in keys. Every cantor and liturgist out there is holding the same note, and it has not slipped once in my lifetime.
